name: Martin Schöll
headline: Helping companies optimize their pricing & build digital products | Co-Founder 🐡 How much is the fish & MD Schöll GmbH

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: We started How much is the fish to help businesses take the best pricing decisions. We have tried the tools on the market and know how difficult it is to get reliable data that is also well prepared. That's why we are building How much is the fish with the vision to become your holistic tool for e-commerce competitive intelligence and pricing decisions.

positions.title: Managing Director
positions.description:
I founded Schöll GmbH with a mission to elevate the digital capabilities of SMEs through consulting and software development services.

We offer interim management, coaching and consulting in the areas of product management, program management, product development and general business consulting.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Managing Director
positions.description:
We’ve founded TruckOS with a mission to empower truckers by providing an operating system to manage their daily operations. TruckOS secured EUR 1m in pre-seed funding from VCs and business angels before taking the strategic decision to liquidate the company in Q4 2023.
- Developed initial product hypothesis, then validated and revised it through experimentation and interviewing, resulting in a prioritized product roadmap leading to high user satisfaction
- With a development team of 4 (product, design & engineering) we launched a production grade SaaS “Mini-TMS” (Transportation Management System) in 3 months - another 3 months later, we had launched native apps for iOS & Android and pushed more than 2 releases weekly to continuously improve user satisfaction based on feedback and analytics insights
- Despite continuously growing praise from our early users, I facilitated the difficult decision to liquidate the company as there was no positive outlook on raising required follow-up funding
- As Managing Director, I also took care of various operational topics, e.g. financial planning, bookkeeping, annual reports & shareholder meetings

positions.title: Director TPM
positions.description:
Vay is a technology-enabled mobility company taking a contrarian approach to driverless mobility based on teledriving. Vay has raised more than USD 100m in funding from investors including Kinnevik, Coatue, Eurazeo, Atomico, La Famiglia and Creandum as well as prominent Business Angels such as former Alphabet CFO Patrick Pichette, Spotify’s CTO & CPO Gustav Söderström and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg.

I have built-up and lead the teams for Technical Program Management and Technical Product Management at Vay.
